# SynForecast Examples

Explore our tutorials to learn how to generate synthetic time series data with SynForecast.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start Guide](getting_started.ipynb) - Generate your first synthetic time series

## Generator Tutorials

### Statistical Generators
- [Random Walk](random_walk.ipynb) - Simple random walk processes
- [Seasonal](seasonal.ipynb) - Time series with seasonal patterns
- [SARIMA](sarima.ipynb) - Seasonal ARIMA models
- [ETS](ets.ipynb) - Exponential smoothing state space models
- [INAR](inar.ipynb) - Integer-valued autoregression

### Stochastic Generators
- [GARCH](garch.ipynb) - Volatility clustering models
- [Ornstein-Uhlenbeck](ornstein_uhlenbeck.ipynb) - Mean-reverting processes
- [Geometric Brownian Motion](geometric_brownian_motion.ipynb) - Log-normal random walks
- [Jump Diffusion](jump_diffusion.ipynb) - Processes with jumps
- [Poisson Process](poisson_process.ipynb) - Event arrival processes
- [Cyclic](cyclic.ipynb) - Cyclic oscillations
- [Fractional Brownian Motion](fractional_brownian_motion.ipynb) - Long-memory processes
- [Hawkes Process](hawkes_process.ipynb) - Self-exciting point processes
- [Stochastic Volatility](stochastic_volatility.ipynb) - Time-varying volatility
- [Regime Switching](regime_switching.ipynb) - Markov regime processes
- [Chaotic Systems](chaotic_system.ipynb) - Lorenz, logistic, and Mackey-Glass dynamics
- [Bounded Processes](bounded_process.ipynb) - Beta-AR and logit-normal processes
- [Levy Processes](levy_process.ipynb) - Alpha-stable processes

### Multivariate Generators
- [Copula](copula.ipynb) - Dependency-structured multivariate series
- [VAR](var.ipynb) - Vector autoregressive models
- [Gaussian Process](gaussian_process.ipynb) - Kernel-based correlated series

- [Intermittent Demand](intermittent_demand.ipynb) - Sparse demand patterns

### Pretraining Generators
- [TSI](tsi.ipynb) - Trend, seasonality, and irregularity composition
